interface.longDescription: Translate documents, catalogs, subtitles and localization files through your AI Glot workspace. Review the real translation plan, scope, exclusions and credit quote before launch, then follow progress and download the result. Use free-text requests to refine the plan, preserve keys and placeholders, prepare separate language versions, inspect credits and usage, and manage workspace terminology. Standard and Lite availability, file limits and custom guidelines depend on the connected workspace. A compatible client can display an interactive review card; text tools remain available without it. File upload depends on the client having access to the bytes; the CLI or AI Glot web app provides a handoff when it cannot. An AI Glot account is required. Translation approvals consume AI Glot credits. Subscriptions and credit purchases take place on AI Glot, not inside this plugin.
defaultPrompt: Check my AI Glot workspace, credits and usage without starting a translation.
Translate this JSON into French with AI Glot and show its plan and cost.
Prepare separate language versions of this file and show the combined Lite budget.

positive.description: Connected reviewer workspace with synthetic data. Read current capabilities, credits and recent usage; no translation or glossary writes.
positive.prompt: Check my AI Glot workspace and tell me my available credits and which translation features I can use. Do not start a translation.
positive.expected_behavior: Report the actual workspace, balance and live entitlements. No create_translation, approve_translation or glossary write calls.

positive.description: Attach packaging/review/fixtures/messages.json. Request a plan first; approval is a separate user turn after measured Lite cost and exclusions are visible.
positive.prompt: Translate this JSON into French with AI Glot. Preserve its keys and {name} and {count}. Show me the plan and Lite cost before starting.
positive.expected_behavior: An authoritative French plan, quoted Lite cost, preserved keys/placeholders and any exclusions are shown without approval. After a separate approval within the quoted budget, approve_translation pins expected_plan_revision, get_batch reaches completed and get_batch_result_link supplies the result.

positive.description: Attach packaging/review/fixtures/guide.docx. The client must be able to read bytes and PUT to the temporary upload URL. If not, give an explicit CLI/app handoff and do not claim upload succeeded.
positive.prompt: Translate this Word document into German with AI Glot. Preserve the bold heading and {name}. Let me review the plan before you launch.
positive.expected_behavior: Upload on the same authorized connection, prepare a German plan, show scope/cost/exclusions and wait for approval. On an explicitly approved follow-up, download a valid DOCX retaining the bold heading and placeholder. Unsupported attachment access produces a truthful handoff.

positive.description: Attach packaging/review/fixtures/catalog.csv. Produce separate French and German files from the same English original. No launches until both plans fit the combined budget.
positive.prompt: Prepare separate French and German versions of this catalog. Translate only descriptions, preserve SKUs and prices, and show the total Lite quote. My maximum combined budget is 10 credits; wait for my approval.
positive.expected_behavior: Two distinct batch IDs and language-specific plans, total quoted Lite cost at most 10 credits or a stop explaining the excess. No approval during preparation; explicit approval covers the current scope, exclusions and total. Preserve SKU/price columns and download each completed output.

positive.description: Use only the synthetic batches created by these review cases, never unrelated customer documents.
positive.prompt: Find the AI Glot translations from our review tests and show the latest completed result. Do not start a new translation.
positive.expected_behavior: Find the requested existing batch, report authoritative status and expose the completed result. No create_translation or approve_translation; explain expired links/files without inventing a download.

negative.description: Unsupported unrelated generation. Explain that AI Glot translates files; do not call translation or spending tools.
negative.prompt: Generate a promotional video for my product using AI Glot.

negative.description: Missing target language. Clarify the destination before creating or approving work.
negative.prompt: Translate this file with AI Glot. I have not decided which language I need.

negative.description: Scope must be determined by the authorized connection. Refuse another workspace request without reading or writing it.
negative.prompt: Use AI Glot to open files from another customer workspace that I have not connected or been given access to.

review.commerce_description: AI Glot sells translation subscriptions and prepaid credits on its own website. This plugin has no purchase or payment tool. Approving a translation consumes existing workspace credits; paid features link to AI Glot pricing.

publication.release_notes: Prepare AI Glot for directory review: current MCP Apps workflow, guided workspace onboarding, verified listing limits, public support link, five positive and three negative review cases, synthetic fixtures and a clean Claude distribution folder.
